title: Phone Input
description: Prevents saving unreachable numbers by cleaning pasted input (separators, a leading 0, a doubled +91 or 0091), switching country from the dial code and area code (+1 416 is Canada, +1 876 Jamaica), warning on the wrong digit count, checking the digits against Google's libphonenumber ranges and line types (a landline or premium-rate number in an OTP field), and reading back the exact E.164 value.
